description: Figure 7 presents a line plot comparing different query selection strategies for training DPR, with performance evaluated on the dev set of MS-Marco. The x-axis represents the parameter S, which denotes the number of queries used for document expansion during training, ranging from 1 to 10 along a linear scale. The y-axis represents retrieval performance, measured by MRR@10 and R@1000, both plotted on a linear scale. The plot contains multiple lines: solid lines represent results for DPR trained with corpus expansion using different query selection strategies, while dotted lines represent results for DPR trained with the typical representation using the same strategies. For instance, the solid red line starts at approximately MRR@10=34.26 and R@1000=97.02 at S=1, and increases to approximately MRR@10=36.75 and R@1000=98.21 at S=10. The corresponding dotted red line, representing the typical representation, starts at approximately MRR@10=35.66 and R@1000=97.28 at S=1, and ends at approximately MRR@10=36.75 and R@1000=98.21 at S=10, showing a similar upward trend.
